## Design

### 2026-10-25 – I've been brainstorming this session and I've got the idea on how I want to make it work, and I also happened to make one note work or sound like a guitar, now I just need to fine tune the circuit to

**2.4h**

I've been brainstorming this session and I've got the idea on how I want to make it work, and I also happened to make one note work or sound like a guitar, now I just need to fine tune the circuit to let it sound softer or creamy instead of super harsh, and I also need to figure out the frequency circuit to let it have adjustable frequencies. Most of this time I spent so far was trying to get a design to work and sound like  guitar, so I can further work on this foundation.
